description: This source file implements a stress-testing application for disk cache crash recovery. It launches child processes, manages cache entries, and simulates crashes to verify cache robustness. The main functions include process control, cache operations, and crash simulation, with multi-threaded cache management and crash handling.

classes.name: EntryWrapper
classes.description: Encapsulates a cache entry and manages its lifecycle, including opening, reading, writing, deleting, and idling operations, with asynchronous callbacks.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Holds shared data for cache operations, including counters, cache instance, keys, and entries.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoOpen
methods.description: Initiates opening or creating a cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::OnOpenDone
methods.description: Handles completion of open/create cache entry operation.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoRead
methods.description: Reads data from the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoWrite
methods.description: Writes data to the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::OnWriteDone
methods.description: Handles completion of write operation, possibly deleting or closing the entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoIdle
methods.description: Marks the entry as idle and schedules further operations.

methods.name: StressTheCache
methods.description: Runs a thread that continuously adds/removes entries from the cache, simulating crashes.

methods.name: CrashCallback
methods.description: Triggers process termination to simulate a crash.

methods.name: RunSoon
methods.description: Schedules a crash to occur after a delay.

methods.name: StartCrashThread
methods.description: Starts a thread that will trigger crashes periodically.

methods.name: CrashHandler
methods.description: Handles crash events, possibly breaking into debugger.
